text:
Maya: Quick perf note — ran a 2h load test across eu-west + eu-central with the new continuous-batching tweaks. TL;DR: enabling cross-zone spillover at token_budget=30 reduced drops but produced ~9% p99 token latency bump in eu-west.

Kevin: Can you paste the profiler output? curious about kernel switching overhead.

Maya: Here — trimmed runtime perf dump:
```
kernel_switches: 124
avg_batch_ms: 18.3
kv_cache_misses: 0.12
kv_warmup_time_ms: 540
spill_events: 213
```

Sasha: kv_warmup_time looks pretty high. Are we warming the full KV shard on every spill or doing partial prefetch? :eyes: 

Arjun: We currently do full shard-level warmup on first hit. That explains the ~500ms spike and the extra latency for the first token after a spill.

Priya: If we move to lazy prefix-warmup (prefetch only the top keys used in the first N tokens) we can probably shave 200–300ms off that cold path. More complex but doable.

Kevin: Also check kernel-selection thrash — kernel switches seem correlated with spill events. Model falls back to fp16 kernels instead of the quantized path on some machines; that adds overhead.

Maya: Saw >20 kernel swaps/min in the trace. Proposed changes: 1) increase token_budget target for cross-zone spill from 30 -> 50 for EU to favor locality, 2) enable lazy KV prefetch, 3) add a short spill holdback (300ms) to avoid rapid re-spilling between zones.

Sasha: :thumbsup: Sounds reasonable. What's the expected cost impact from a higher token_budget?

Maya: Simulated cost increase ~6% (batch shaping + fewer tiny batches) but availability improved and we had fewer retries. Net unit-cost slightly higher but p99 better.

Arjun: Can we run a 3h A/B test: odd minutes policy A (budget=30) and even minutes policy B (budget=50), collecting p50/p95/p99 + kernel-switch counts + kv_miss rates? That should give clear signal.

Priya: I can wire up the eval set and alerts. Also adding a runtime flag: runtime.perf.kv_prefetch=lazy so we can toggle without redeploy.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: perf-experiment/2026-03-18T09:00Z -> staging (rolling 5%) :rocket:

Maya: Added the run config. Results will land in s3://redwood-perf/runs/1977778888. I'll post a summary when finished. Thanks!

Kevin: :eyes: We'll watch for tail regressions and any quantization-profile drift.

Sasha: :thinking_face: Also remember cross-region egress if we increase spill frequency — please tag requests for egress breakdown.

Maya: Good call — I'll add egress tagging so billing can break down the experiments.

Arjun: One more item: kernel selector should prefer the quantized path when model variant is compatible. I'll add a guard to avoid kernel-switches triggered by spill events for 1s. Should reduce thrash.

Maya: Nice. I'll coordinate follow-ups in the perf doc and close the loop after the run.

Priya: I'll monitor and post any alert hits.

Maya: Thanks team!
